answer.reason: The only verse that names Ishvi (1SA 14:49) lists him among Saul's children, which the summary already says; the other marked verses name other sons of Saul (Abinadab, Eshbaal) and do not mention him.
doubts: 1SA 31:2, 1CH 8:33, 1CH 9:39 and 1CH 10:2 are marked but do not name Ishvi; they list Abinadab, Malchishua and Eshbaal, and Ishvi is not stated to have died at Gilboa.
